svg.title: 73% of the value force-closed on 5 Nov fell inside US stock-market hours
svg.desc: Bar chart of the value force-closed in each hour of 5 Nov (UTC), in millions of US dollars. The busiest hours are inside the US stock-market session, which is shaded: 73% of the day's value fell inside it. The same numbers are in the table below.
svg.text: 73% of the value force-closed on 5 Nov fell inside US
Value force-closed in each hour of 5 Nov (UTC), in millions of US dollars. The shaded band
is the US stock-market session, 14:30 to 21:00 UTC (9:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. New York time). Hour
07 UTC had fewer than 10 wallets and is not shown.
